journey.name: Starter: counter on-chain happy path
journey.description:
Every contract call the quickstart has: deploy a counter, then increment it. That is the whole surface of counter.compact — one exported circuit, `increment` — so a run that deploys and increments has exercised all of it.
This is the first on-chain thing anyone following the published quickstart does, which makes it the worst place for a silent regression. The existing starter journeys stop at the sigil-less screen; this one goes through proving, dust-fee balancing and submission, where every failure found on real devices actually lives.
Preconditions this journey does NOT set up, and fails honestly without: - a debuggable build whose local.properties sets kuira.dev.seed, so there is a wallet without a passkey ceremony, and kuira.blockfrost.projectId, so PreProd answers at all; - that wallet funded on PreProd, with dust registered.
The first run on a wallet with no checkpoint spends ~12 minutes syncing dust before the deploy can pay its fee. That happens once per wallet per device.
NOT YET RUN end to end — the strings come from the app's own source, not from a watched run.
